name: gnome-app-tray
description: A Windows-like expandable tray for background apps in the GNOME top bar.

scripts.syntax:check: node --check extension.js && node --check prefs.js && node --check lib/appTrayMenu.js && node --check tests/shell-smoke.js && bash -n tools/*.sh && python3 -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(path.read_text()) for path in pathlib.Path('tools').glob('*.py')]"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run syntax:check && npm run metadata:check && npm run schema:check
